title: Replication Package for "Process Mining and Stochastic Modeling for Software Process Forecasting: A Systematic Mapping Study with an LLM-Assisted Protocol"
description: Version 3 of the replication artefact for the systematic mapping study (Information and Software Technology). Corpus after ML complementary search, Wohlin snowballing to saturation, IC1 filter, and Phase-2 blind flips: n = 1710 included studies. Search: five databases (Scopus, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, SpringerLink, Web of Science); eligibility window from 1 January 1994; searches executed 12 April 2026. Package includes: search strings; deduplication/enrichment/screening pipelines; LLM prompts and schemas; human verification and blind re-screen sheets (Phase-2 κ = 1.00, n = 117); caminho_completo protocols and decision sheets; RQ3 priority human extraction (293) plus suggestion-assisted core coding (1417); SPMF and venue summaries; canonical studies.json and included_studies_1710.csv; SEGRESS checklist. PDFs of primary studies are not redistributed (copyright). Step-2 recall pre-registration: 10.5281/zenodo.24148068. Cite all versions / concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21939599.
